# Psych Scene Hub

> > Psych Scene Hub is a comprehensive psychiatry education platform featuring evidence-based clinical frameworks, expert video content, and psychopharmacology resources for mental health professionals.

Founded by Dr. Sanil Rege, Psych Scene Hub combines modern psychiatric education with practical clinical tools including DSM-5/ICD-11 standards, diagnostic frameworks, and treatment protocols. The platform offers subscription-based access to video lectures, clinical insights, and reference materials covering ADHD, mood disorders, psychopharmacology, and emerging psychiatric research.

## Core Platform

- [Psych Scene Hub: The Psychiatry Textbook of the Future](https://psychscenehub.com): Homepage introducing Psych Scene Hub psychiatry platform with DSM, ADHD, psychopharmacology content.
- [About Us - Psych Scene Hub](https://psychscenehub.com/about-us): About page describing Psych Scene Hub mission, Hub Pro subscription, and Dr Sanil Rege.
- [Psych Scene Hub - Psych Scene Hub](https://psychscenehub.com/subscription): Subscription and pricing page for Psych Scene Hub and Academy access levels.
- [Membership Checkout - Psych Scene Hub](https://psychscenehub.com/membership-account/membership-checkout): Membership checkout and payment form for Hub Pro subscription registration.

## Video Education & Clinical Frameworks

- [Video Archive - Psych Scene Hub](https://psychscenehub.com/video): Video archive covering ADHD, psychopharmacology, mood disorders, and psychiatric education.
- [ADHD Diagnostic Domains: A Six-Domain Clinical Framework](https://psychscenehub.com/video/adhd-diagnostic-domains-2): Video on six-domain ADHD diagnostic framework by Dr Sanil Rege for structured assessment.
- [ADHD Medication Psychosis Risk Framework](https://psychscenehub.com/video/adhd-medication-psychosis-risk-2): Video on ADHD medication psychosis risk screening framework by Dr Sanil Rege.
- [Lithium and Dementia Risk: Neuroprotection Explained](https://psychscenehub.com/video/lithium-dementia-risk-neuroprotection): Video on lithium's neuroprotective effects and dementia risk in bipolar disorder by Dr Jonathan Meyer.
- [Ketamine in TRD: Response vs Recovery](https://psychscenehub.com/video/ketamine-treatment-resistant-depression-response-recovery): Video reviewing ketamine in treatment-resistant depression comparing response and recovery outcomes.
- [Neuroinflammation in Psychiatry and Autoimmune Overlap](https://psychscenehub.com/video/neuroinflammation-psychiatry-autoimmune-overlap): Video on neuroinflammation, HPA axis dysfunction, and psychiatric-autoimmune overlap by Dr Sanil Rege.
- [The Neurobiology of Hunger in Psychiatry](https://psychscenehub.com/video/neurobiology-of-hunger-psychiatry): Video on hunger neurobiology relevant to obesity, eating disorders, and GLP-1 treatment.

## Clinical Resources & Guides

- [Psych Bytes - Psych Scene Hub](https://psychscenehub.com/psychbytes): Glossary and reference for psychiatry and pharmacology concepts with DSM-5 and ICD-11 standards.
- [Anxiety Disorders: Clinical Guide for Psychiatrists and Mental Health Professionals](https://psychscenehub.com/psychscenehub/anxiety-disorders): Clinical guide on anxiety disorders with diagnostic frameworks and evidence-based management strategies.
- [General Mental Health Education: Resources for Psychiatrists & Clinicians](https://psychscenehub.com/psychscenehub/general-mental-health-education): Foundational mental health education resources and clinical training materials for psychiatrists.

## Expert Articles & Insights

- [Psych Insights Archive - Psych Scene Hub](https://psychscenehub.com/psychinsights): Archive of clinical insights on psychopharmacology, psychiatric disorders, and treatment approaches.
- [Psych Insights: Expert Articles on Psychiatry, Clinical Practice & Research](https://psychscenehub.com/psychscenehub/psych-insight): Expert articles on psychiatry, clinical cases, psychopharmacology, and mental health research.
- [Psychiatry & Neuroscience News: Clinical Updates & Research | Psych Scene Hub](https://psychscenehub.com/psychscenehub/psychiatry-and-neuroscience-latest-news): Clinical news and research updates on psychiatry, neuroscience, and mental health breakthroughs.
